And you need to have someone in that job that is actually strong enough to do what you promised the American people. If confirmed as Secretary, I'll ensure that our exceptional, extraordinary Border Patrol agents have all the tools and resources and support that they need to carry out their mission effectively. The same is true of my commitment to the outstanding men and women of the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement. They are responsible for apprehending, detaining, and deporting illegal immigrants. My goal and my mission is to build trust. We will undertake a large job and a large duty that we have to fulfill. That the American people expect us to do by securing our borders. To make sure that our nation is a nation with borders or we’re no nation at all. And that we are making sure that those criminal actors that are perpetuating violence in our communities and in our cities and towns and States are removed from this country. That there's consequences for breaking the law in our country again. We can ensure that the United States remains a beacon of freedom, safety, and security for generations to come.

title: "Angel Parents tell their story at the White House"
text: My name's Angie Morphine Vargas and I'm mother to Ruben Morphine. He was executed in the streets of Selenus in 1990. 34 years later, I could still cry for him like if it was yesterday. My name is Maria Vera Vega and I'm the mother of Marine and Border Patrol agent Javier Vega Jr. Our son, who went by Harvey, was murdered August the 3rd, 2014. My name is Chris Odette. I'm an angel father. My daughter, Kisha, was killed September 12th, 2014 by an illegal alien in Rock Wall, Texas. This is my son Ryan and his girlfriend, both poisoned to death by elicit fentanyl. I can't bring my son back, but we are doing all of this to save the future Americans from being poisoned to death by fentanyl. My name is Agnes Gibbony. This is my son, Ronald D Silva, who was murdered by a previously deported criminal illegal alien gang member. My name is Angel Miriam Mendoza. This is my son, Sergeant Brandon Mendoza of the Mesa, Arizona Police Department, who was killed on May 12th, 2014 by a repeat illegal criminal. Thank everybody in this administration for finally paying attention to criminals who harm Americans. We thank the Trump administration from the bottom of our hearts. Without them, there would be no justice for my daughter. We're finally getting some justice in this country for our children. This right here is what should be living here in America, not criminals that are coming in right now.
